text: Granddaughter, 8 years old, temperature 38.3. I've found some small dark specks on her, and one larger patch on her arm like a bruise she can't explain. On her own skin they're not easy to make out, she's very dark, so I checked the palms of her hands and the soles of her feet and inside her bottom eyelids, and they're there, purplish. I pressed a clear tumbler on them and they stayed put. Please advise.
